fields.statement: QA cycle 1: built this branch's rhiza (go build -trimpath) and ran it in a scratch repo with a bare origin and a gh shim whose 'run view --log-failed' prints real logs fetched with gh from dphaener/nebari's failed Actions runs. With run 42339573426's log (nebari#72's red head, 5295 lines, 'Failed examples:' then 'rspec ./spec/views/tasks/list_spec.rb:290 # tasks/_list ...'), the first ship check --settled --json reran the run and the second listed tests ['rspec ./spec/views/tasks/list_spec.rb:290'] and one finding with that test and no comment text; ship check --test-failures exited 0. An infra-only log ('Error: Process completed with exit code 1.') gave detail 'failed: test', no tests, and --test-failures exited 1 with 'no failing test was recorded for the head'. Defect seen: runs 42331018773 and 42329799773 print RSpec's id form 'rspec ./spec/system/garden_location_spec.rb[1:1:11] # ...', which ship check names 'rspec ./spec/system/garden_location_spec.rb[1:1:11' (closing bracket dropped), recorded as a qa finding.
